description.value: Cha House is a bubble tea café located in Richmond's Templeton Station area, near the Canada Line transit hub at 7899 Templeton Station Road. It sits in a multi-unit commercial development (unit 1024), placing it in a transit-accessible node that cyclists following the Richmond cycling network may pass through. The OSM record identifies its specialty as bubble tea.
